item.description: 1.Introduction Miang Kham (Thai: เมี่ยงคำ) is a traditional Thai bite‑sized leaf‑wrapped snack whose name literally means “one‑bite wrap.” It is widely celebrated for delivering seven distinct flavors—sweet, sour, salty, spicy, bitter, astringent, and aromatic—in a single mouthful.
